migration_catalog_hash.ordering: migration filename ascending by Unicode code point
migration_catalog_hash.framing: SHA-256 domain prefix system-backup-migration-catalog.v1 followed by repeated unsigned 64-bit big-endian byte length plus UTF-8 filename bytes, then unsigned 64-bit big-endian byte length plus UTF-8 SQL content bytes
migration_catalog_hash.line_endings: CRLF and bare CR in SQL content are normalized to LF before UTF-8 framing; all other content bytes, including the final newline, are preserved

schema_hash.ordering: object_type then object_name; nested table columns, indexes and foreign keys use ordinal positions and stable names
schema_hash.non_table_objects: include server version, SQL mode, object type/name and SHA-256 of the database-returned definition after CRLF/CR are normalized to LF; do not otherwise rewrite case, whitespace, quoted identifiers, strings or DEFINER
schema_hash.canonical_bytes: UTF-8 canonical JSON containing exactly algorithm and normalized sorted objects; capture time, database/schema name, credentials and business rows are excluded
schema_hash.status: canonicalizer, deterministic result and fail-closed reviewed-evidence input draft; authenticated live evidence pending
